description:
Activate Adarkar Valkyrie by tapping it, causing Gerrard to be returned from your graveyard to the battlefield the next time it dies this turn.
Activate Goblin Bombardment twice by sacrificing Gerrard and Adarkar Valkyrie.
Adarkar Valkyrie and Gerrard trigger.
Resolve the Adarkar Valkyrie trigger, returning Gerrard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Gerrard trigger, returning all artifact and creature cards that were put into your graveyard this turn from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment abilities, dealing 2 damage to any target(s).
Repeat.
